p: Rav Sheizvi said in the name of Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya:
which is written: “The slothful man [remiyya] will not roast [yaḥarokh] his prey” … The deceitful [harammai] hunter, … will not live [yiḥye] a long [ya’arikh] life.

which is written: “The slothful man [remiyya] will not roast [yaḥarokh] his prey” (Proverbs 12:27)? The deceitful [harammai] hunter, i.e., one who tricks people into believing that he has acquired vast stores of knowledge by studying new material without reviewing that which he has already learned, will not live [yiḥye] a long [ya’arikh] life.
This is comparable to a person who is hunting birds;
if he breaks the wings of the first
will not remain in his possession,
